mapper.select: SELECT id FROM shopping_list WHERE user_id=#{user} AND id=#{list} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM shopping_product_match WHERE user_id=#{user} AND request_id=CAST(#{request} AS uuid)
SELECT * FROM shopping_product_match WHERE user_id=#{user} AND list_id=#{list} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM shopping_product_match WHERE user_id=#{user} AND list_id=#{list} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO shopping_product_match(user_id,list_id,request_id,input_hash,source_fingerprint,city_code,catalog_version,matching_status, estimated_demand_cost,consumption_cost,purchase_outlay,known_subtotal,unknown_item_count,estimated_known_subtotal,estimated_unknown_item_count,budget_status,view_json) VALUES(#{row.userId},#{row.listId},CAST(#{row.requestId} AS uuid),#{row.inputHash},#{row.sourceFingerprint},#{row.cityCode},#{row.catalogVersion},#{row.matchingStatus}, CAST(#{costs.estimatedDemandCost} AS numeric),CAST(#{costs.consumptionCost} AS numeric),CAST(#{costs.purchaseOutlay} AS numeric),CAST(#{costs.knownSubtotal} AS numeric),#{costs.unknownItemCount},CAST(#{costs.estimatedKnownSubtotal} AS numeric),#{costs.estimatedUnknownItemCount},#{costs.budgetStatus},CAST(#{row.viewJson} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT(user_id,request_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopping_product_match_item(match_id,user_id,list_id,line_order,item_key,ingredient_id,unit_code,required_amount,shortage_amount,status, product_id,package_amount,package_unit,package_price,package_count,consumption_cost,purchase_outlay,estimated_demand_cost,quote_json) VALUES(#{id},#{user},#{list},#{order},#{line.itemKey},CAST(#{line.ingredientId} AS bigint),#{line.unitCode},CAST(#{line.requiredAmount} AS numeric),CAST(#{line.shortageAmount} AS numeric),#{line.status}, #{line.product.productId},CAST(#{line.product.packageAmount} AS numeric),#{line.product.packageUnit},CAST(#{line.product.packagePrice} AS numeric),CAST(#{line.packageCount} AS numeric),CAST(#{line.consumptionCost} AS numeric),CAST(#{line.purchaseOutlay} AS numeric),CAST(#{line.estimatedDemandCost} AS numeric),CAST(#{line.product, typeHandler=com.cooker.shopping.mapper.ProductQuoteJsonTypeHandler} AS jsonb))

INSERT INTO shopping_product_purchase_group(match_id,user_id,list_id,group_key,product_id,unit_code,quantity,package_count,purchase_outlay) VALUES(#{id},#{user},#{list},#{group.groupKey},#{group.product.productId},#{group.unitCode},CAST(#{group.quantity} AS numeric),CAST(#{group.packageCount} AS numeric),CAST(#{group.purchaseOutlay} AS numeric))
mapper.update: UPDATE shopping_product_match SET view_json=CAST(#{view} AS jsonb) WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{user}
